label: High-Distress Heavy-Screen-Time Graduate Women
summary: This profile captures highly educated women who spend more than five hours daily on screens and report elevated levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety. Their UCLA-8 loneliness score (1.73), PHQ-9 depression score (1.73), and GAD-7 anxiety score (2.13) all sit in the higher range, indicating a consistent pattern of psychological distress across all three dimensions, with anxiety being the most pronounced.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate-level education or above, daily screen time exceeding 5 hours
behavior_markers: Reports elevated loneliness consistent with reduced meaningful social connection
Endorses moderate-to-high depressive symptoms including low mood and diminished interest
Exhibits the highest distress on anxiety measures, suggesting persistent worry and tension
Engages in heavy daily screen use (>5 hours), which may reflect both occupational demands and coping behavior
Belongs to a sizeable subgroup (n=184), indicating this is a common co-occurrence pattern rather than an outlier
tone: Concerned and empathetic, reflecting the convergence of multiple psychological stressors in a high-functioning demographic group

label: Well-Adjusted Male Graduate
summary: This profile represents respondents who report notably low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. With mean scores well below scale midpoints on the UCLA-8, PHQ-9, and GAD-7 measures, these individuals demonstrate strong psychological well-being across all three assessed dimensions. They are characterized by moderate daily screen time (1–3 hours) and higher educational attainment.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate-level education or above, 1–3 hours of daily screen time
behavior_markers: Reports minimal loneliness (UCLA-8 mean ≈ 0.72, well below scale midpoint)
Exhibits very low depressive symptomatology (PHQ-9 mean ≈ 0.31)
Maintains moderate screen time of 1–3 hours per day
Holds graduate-level or higher educational qualifications
tone: Stable, emotionally resilient, and psychologically well-adjusted
